name: Freshservice
task: A help desk, tickets or a shared inbox
summary: AI-powered IT service management (ITSM) from Freshworks: cloud help desk, ticketing, asset management and workflow automation to run IT support and internal service desks without heavy ITIL overhead.
best_for: IT teams that want proper ITSM (incidents, assets, changes, service catalog) running in weeks, without enterprise-suite implementation pain
skip_if: you need a simple shared helpdesk (Freshdesk-class is cheaper) or you're at the scale where ServiceNow's depth is genuinely required
honest_knock: The $19 headline rarely survives contact with a real deployment: the ITSM features most IT teams buy for (change/problem management, deeper analytics) live at Pro, and so does Freddy AI Copilot, a $29-an-agent add-on offered only on Pro and Enterprise. Orchestration runs and, from Growth up, 100 asset units come included; you pay extra only past those allowances. Price the tier that contains your must-haves plus the add-ons you would switch on, not the starter row. Within that honesty, it's one of the fastest ITSM tools to actually stand up.

pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-29 against the vendor's own pricing page) Per agent, read 29 Sep 2026 on freshworks.com/freshservice/pricing/: Starter $19/agent/mo billed annually or $29 monthly; Growth $49 or $59; Pro $99 or $119. Enterprise is quote-only again: the card now reads 'Custom' with a 'Contact us' button. The page's own plan data still carries $139 annual and $167 monthly for it, but with a hidePrices flag set and 'Custom' as the display text, so those two numbers are not an offer (on 1 Sep 2026 they were printed). Monthly billing costs 53% more on Starter and about 20% more on Growth and Pro. The same plan data carries a euro set -- Starter EUR 15 annual / EUR 25 monthly, Growth 40/50, Pro 84/102 -- in which the Starter monthly surcharge is 67%, not 53%. Add-ons and allowances: Freddy AI Copilot $29/agent/mo, offered on the Pro and Enterprise cards only and still an add-on on Enterprise even though that card now says 'Freddy AI included' (what is included there is the Freddy AI Agent (Classic) at 1,200 sessions per Enterprise licence per year, plus Freddy AI Insights); orchestration transactions included at 1,000/2,000/5,000/20,000 per account per month with extra packs at $250 per 1,000; MCP actions allowanced at 1,200, 6,000 or 12,000 a year with packs at $15 per 1,000; an e-signature pack at $90 for 30 signature credits; project management licences at $15/user/mo; a Business Agent licence for non-IT teams at $49/agent/mo on Pro and Enterprise only; connector app tasks at $80 per 5,000 after a one-time 500 free. Growth, Pro and Enterprise include the ITAM Growth package and 100 asset units (Starter does not); further units are sold in packs of 500. Three free Day Passes for occasional agents at signup, more from $3. 14-day free trial with all features. FAQ: upgrades apply instantly, downgrades and cancellations only at the end of the term.
